extension.summary: Offline artwork metadata for the Filmnet add-on
extension.description: Ships a pre-built SQLite lookup table that maps IMDb and Trakt IDs to TMDB poster and fanart paths, so the Filmnet video add-on can resolve artwork without calling the TMDB API. It is maintained separately from the add-on itself so the add-on can be distributed faster.
extension.news: v3.0.0 - Modernised addon.xml for Kodi 19+ (xbmc.python 3.0.0, assets manifest, license and localised summary/description) - Rebuilt meta.db: added an imdb index, a tmdb column and deduplicated IMDb IDs - Normalised file permissions and line endings
